_comment: What `lead-engine monitor` (hourly) treats as a problem, and what the daily summary and the Results page count as fixed monthly costs (design 7.9 and 7.10). Thresholds are deliberately below the hard limits in caps.json, so a person hears before the engine pauses itself.

data._comment: MCA publishes the month's incorporation file in the first days of the next month; after this day (IST) its absence is an alert.

runs._comment: Hours after which a source's last run counts as stale: the nightly batch (which includes the need engine) daily, the portals weekly (ops/SCHEDULE.md). Startup India is not scheduled, so it is not watched.

backups._comment: Checked only where the backup folder exists (the server): the newest full backup (nightly) and critical one (hourly).

summary._comment: The daily summary goes to SUMMARY_TO (comma-separated team addresses) at 08:00 IST, from mailbox-1 when OUTREACH_TRANSPORT=smtp, otherwise into the outbox.

fixed_costs_inr_per_month.item: S3 storage for raw pages and exports
Server (the existing server; ₹900 if a t4g.small is needed)
